description: Reusable authored-pose direction for guardian player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies tower-shield protection choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: immovable, protective, economical, and heavily grounded, with shield-first weight transfer and deliberate armored recovery
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's heavy plate, tower shield, weapon, insignia, and accessory count. Keep exactly one shield and one depicted weapon in their original hands; never duplicate, swap, discard, resize wildly, or transform them.
identity.magicRule: Guardian defense is physical. Do not add magical barriers, runes, aura, or projectiles unless explicitly present in the portrait, and then keep any accent small and subordinate to shield mechanics.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, heavy plate, tower shield, weapon, palette, proportions, and insignia. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact fortified silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered guardian in a shield-planted defensive stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall guardian motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, armor, palette, proportions, shield, weapon, and insignia. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A patient breathing loop adjusts tower-shield coverage, stance width, and weapon readiness without exposing the torso.
idle.effectRule: No active effect; only subtle armor, cape, and shield-grip settling.

measured inhale behind the shield
weight settles deeper onto the forward leg
shield angle closes over the torso
centered immovable midpoint
controlled exhale with armor settling

fortified guard flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A slow alternating armored advance maintains tower-shield coverage through contacts, compressed steps, passing poses, and weapon counterbalance.
walk.effectRule: No active magic or strike; armor, straps, and cloth respond to each weighted step.
frameDescriptions: left foot forward with tower shield leading
left leg compresses under full armor
passing pose hidden safely behind shield coverage
right foot reaches while weapon counterbalances
right foot plants behind the shield edge
right leg compresses under armored weight
passing pose as left knee advances
left foot reaches into the guarded advance

attack.motionDirection: The guardian absorbs behind the shield, coils low, drives a planted shield bash, follows with one compact weapon counter, and restores full coverage.
attack.effectRule: A compact physical impact accent may mark the shield contact; no magical barrier, projectile, or effect obscuring the shield edge and feet.
frameDescriptions: fortified guard measuring the target
body compresses fully behind the tower shield
rear leg coils as shield shoulder loads

recovered fortified guard

hurt.motionDirection: A crushing hit jolts the shield inward, forces a short stagger, drops the guardian to a low brace, then resolves through a shield-assisted rise.
hurt.effectRule: One compact physical impact accent only; no gore, blood, ward glow, or lost equipment.

shield jolts inward against the armor

recovered fortified guard

death.motionDirection: A final breach collapses the shield line, knees fail, armor sinks beside the planted shield, and the body reaches a fully fallen rest.
death.effectRule: No gore, blood, magic, or rigid rotation. Keep shield and weapon single, recognizable, and grounded with the body.

weapon arm slackens as stance fails
both armored knees buckle
one knee grounds beside the tipping shield
body rolls into full ground contact
low fallen armor and equipment settle
final fully fallen guardian beside the shield
same final fallen pose held

victory.motionDirection: The guardian confirms safety, rises from cover, plants the shield with authority, salutes with the weapon, and holds an unbroken protective stance.
victory.effectRule: No magic; a restrained metal glint may accent the formal salute.
